name: ski ergometer
description: Pulling the handles of a ski ergometer down in a rhythmic stroke. Works the arms, back and core while raising your heart rate.
instructions: Stand facing the ski ergometer with feet about hip-width apart and grip the handles high in front of you.
Brace your core, soften your knees and hinge at the hips as you pull the handles down toward your thighs.
Let the handles travel back overhead with control, then repeat in a smooth rhythm.
